verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents its own automations that integrate with GitHub and Linear and run in response to webhook events. That suggests issue-tracker events can trigger agent work. However, no evidence shows a flow where a developer takes an existing issue or ticket and hands it to the agent as a coding task. The closest documented flows start from failed workflows, security alerts or Slack mentions, and the issue-related automation only triages and routes issues to owners. Missing for 10: explicit issue/ticket-to-agent assignment flow (e.g., label or mention on a GitHub/Linear issue), docs showing the agent resolving an issue into a PR, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can assign a coding task to an agent directly from an existing issue or ticket

citations.quote: Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more. Run on a schedule or in response to webhook events
Detect failed workflows, inspect logs, identify the likely cause, and open a pull request with a proposed fix.
